description: This file is a shell script for testing pack corruption resilience in Git, including creating test files, corrupting pack objects, and verifying recovery mechanisms.

methods.name: create_test_files
methods.description: Generates test files with random content and specific labels for testing pack corruption resilience.

methods.name: create_new_pack
methods.description: Creates a new Git pack with test objects and verifies it.

methods.name: do_repack
methods.description: Recreates the pack, simulating corruption scenarios.

methods.name: do_corrupt_object
methods.description: Corrupts a specific object in the pack to test recovery.
